sub_limits_waiting_notes: Both Indemnity (Section A) and Benefit (Section B Major Illness rider). 3 plans: Pro/Plus/Premium with different SI ranges.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured per policy year
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Covers room rent, ICU, surgeon/anaesthetist fees, blood, OT charges, telemedicine consultation, prosthetics implanted internally.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All Day Care procedures up to SI (537 covered)

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (includes pre/post hospitalization)

ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurvedic, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy in hospital, AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day Care Centre.

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for harvesting

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs.3,000/5,000/7,000 per hospitalization based on plan

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Major Illness Benefit optional rider: 100% SI or max Rs.25L

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Sum Insured Refill 100% Basic SI on complete or partial utilization
restoration_benefit.notes: Includes Cumulative Bonus or Enhanced Cumulative Bonus.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual from 1st renewal year (varies by plan)

room_rent_capping: Pro Plan: Single Pvt AC Room (1% restriction option for 3-4L); Plus Plan: Single Pvt AC Room (Upgrade option, excluding suite); Premium Plan: Actuals up to SI
icu_capping: Actuals (Plus/Premium); Pro 3-4L: Actuals with 2% restriction option
copayment_trigger_notes: Optional Co-payment 10% or 20% (applied to each admissible claim after Deductible).

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Domestic Emergency Assistance up to Rs.5L (Plus)/Rs.10L (Premium) including Air Ambulance within India for travel 150+ km from home.

notable_exclusions_summary: Arogya Supreme excludes maternity, infertility, OPD, refractive error, war/nuclear injuries, and treatment outside India. Comprehensive policy covering 20 basic benefits and 8 optional add-ons. Sum Insured Refill provides 100% top-up of Basic SI on exhaustion.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement via document submission. 24/7 helpline 1800 210 3366. Settlement timelines per IRDAI norms.
available_riders: Major Illness Benefit (lump-sum up to Rs.25L)
Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization (1.5x/2x)
